notes: Windows x64 portable nightly fork, not a Blender Foundation signed distribution.
Executable digest comes from the pinned Git LFS pointer; hydrate LFS before use.
Package files and runtime probe have separate fingerprints; hashing is not a security audit.
No binaries, DLSS/NGX DLLs or third-party source are redistributed by this integration.
BIKINI_BUILD_INFO is upstream metadata, not proof of the running Blender version.
